routes.name: BUITEMS - University of Balochistan

sources.title: First ever Green Bus Service launched in Quetta

routes.notes: No official route code found (GB-1 is a placeholder). 18 stops reported but names not published; route runs via Airport Road, Zarghoon Road, Anscomb Road, Koila Phatak and Sariab Road. Only terminals listed; their coordinates are OSM campus centroids, not stop positions. Reportedly extended to Sariab Customs (Sept 2025, after Balochistan High Court orders); Dec 2025 reports describe routes Sariab Road - Airport Chowk and University Road - Sariab Mill. OSM node 12699227422 'Green Bus Stop' (30.19336, 67.0044) exists.
